Filter Top Impact Values for Stack Plots (Internal)

Source: R/plot.R
dot-filter_top_impact_values_stack.Rd

Filter data for stack plots to show only top impactful values from GTAP data for internal use.

Usage

.filter_top_impact_values_stack(
  data,
  total_data,
  top_impact,
  group_col,
  panel_var,
  x_axis_from,
  variable_col,
  unit_col,
  stack_value_from
)

Arguments

data

A data frame to filter.

total_data

A data frame with total values.

top_impact

Numeric. Number of top impacts to display.

group_col

Character. Column for grouping data.

panel_var

Character. Column for panel facets.

x_axis_from

Character. Column for x-axis categories.

variable_col

Character. Column for variable identification.

unit_col

Character. Column for unit information.

stack_value_from

Character. Column for stack components.

Value

A filtered data frame.
